reviewDecisions.rationale: Multiple independent company, specialist and news sources verify persistent structural memory tightness and real earnings transmission.
Four distinct origins support record prices, supply constraint and changing DRC market access; company selection remains a separate question.
Useful context but not independently verified enough to create a distinct opportunity versus the stronger memory event.
Downstream caution weakens the earnings bridge; no independent realized-price/order confirmation is frozen.
Physical tightness is real but dominated by logistics/geopolitical disruption and lacks a durable company-specific edge.
AI-power demand is well known; this source does not establish a new company-level expectation gap.
